continuity: The unidentified body ahead of the Embroidered Uniform Guard procession was Hyuk Mujin, who had been sleeping; he has now reunited with the Guard while separated from the person he serves.
Hyuk Mujin is holding a stolen Embroidered Uniform Guard badge after taking it from the unconscious subordinate; Commander Jeong’s men have surrounded him.
An unidentified young man appeared above the procession, claimed the role of mastermind, and addressed Commander Jeong as though they had met; he then denied knowing Jeong.
plot: The man mistaken for a corpse wakes and turns out to be Hyuk Mujin. When an Embroidered Uniform Guard subordinate tries to attack him, Hyuk disarms him with Empty-Hand Seizes the Blade, knocks him out, and takes his water. Commander Jeong dismisses the subordinate for his earlier mistake, then questions Hyuk, who refuses to leave because he serves someone expected to return. Hyuk reveals that the flask came from a stolen Guard badge. As Jeong’s men surround him, Hyuk gives his name and stands his ground. A young man appears in a tree, calls himself the mastermind, and greets Jeong as if they have met before; when Jeong asks whether he knows him, the young man denies it with an insult.
translation_decisions: Render 정천호 as “Commander Jeong” and 호패 as “identity tag,” following the reading copy.
Keep Hyuk Mujin’s irreverent, profane speech distinct from Commander Jeong’s calm, controlled register.

active_continuity: The Divine Physician secured the Blood Soul Gu found in the deceased City Lord of Sichuan Province; it weakens hosts, causes madness, and eventually kills them.
Jin suspects Dark Heaven’s covert killing of the City Lord is part of a scheme targeting the Great Nation, possibly its imperial family.
Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao is traveling toward the imperial capital with Hong Jin and fifty Embroidered Uniform Guard members.
The late Emperor entrusted Hong Jin with Zhu Bao’s care; Hong Jin fears the current Emperor intends harm, while Zhu Bao trusts his elder brother.
Jin’s party reached Jiangsu after an arduous journey and is exhausted; Jin insists the group stay together, and the Divine Physician is traveling with them to treat Jin.
Hyuk Mujin has encountered Commander Jeong and the Embroidered Uniform Guard while separated from the person he serves; he is carrying a stolen Guard badge.
An unidentified young man appeared above the Guard procession, claimed to be its mastermind, and addressed Commander Jeong as if familiar with him before denying that he knew him.
open_questions: Why did Dark Heaven secretly kill the City Lord of Sichuan Province, and is it targeting the Emperor or imperial family?
What does the Emperor intend for Prince Shangshan, and what prompted the imperial decree against Hong Jin?
Who is the young man who appeared above the Guard procession, and what is his connection to the apparent ambush?
What explains the attackers’ unnatural ferocity during the caravan assault?
temporary_decisions: Distinguish 홍건적 as “Red Turban Bandits” from 홍건군 as “Red Turban Army.”

names.notes: Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard procession.

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Young, disciplined, persistent, and talented. Values loyalty and respectable conduct, but is proud, glory-seeking, suspicious of Taekyung, and bluntly critical of the family's disgraced third son; he uses quiet practices such as fishing to empty his mind. He is an avid wuxia reader who sometimes mistakes fictional conventions for reality.
